product_correctness_and_trust.carry_forward: carry is authorized only for Verified plus VerifiedCompleteClosure plus a consumed qualifying proof; Trusted cannot create, retain, or consume carried same-open authority, and rollback clears any carried authority
product_correctness_and_trust.publication: the visible-head update remains an unconditional one-row CAS boundary; there is exactly one COMMIT dispatch per publication attempt, reconciliation is fresh and post-dispatch, and reconciliation time is subtracted from the nested commit interval before being exposed separately
product_correctness_and_trust.rollback_freshness: NotProtected is reported without claiming anti-rollback protection
product_correctness_and_trust.snapshot_verifier: verify_snapshot_closure authenticates the current transition/root closure and every explicitly retained transition/root closure, while unreachable object-table rows remain outside its declared boundary
